reason: SOMETHING — حاجه: حاجه used for an indefinite something is colloquial and also has spelling issues. Do not substitute a new MSA expression.
ALWAYS — دايما: دايما in this spelling is the colloquial always form; the natural MSA alternative دائما is separately preserved.
STAR — ستار: ستار means curtain or covering, not the English star sense; phonetic resemblance does not validate the relationship.
LOT — لوط: لوط is the proper name Lot, not an approved general vocabulary meaning of LOT.
UPON — بعد الظهر: بعد الظهر means afternoon and does not express the preposition upon.
MARK — علامة العلامة: علامة العلامة is an unexplained duplicated possessive phrase, not a normal learner equivalent of mark.
CAMERA — كاميرا الكاميرا: كاميرا الكاميرا is an unexplained duplicated phrase, not a natural vocabulary translation of camera.
LICENSE — ترخيص الترخيص: ترخيص الترخيص is an unexplained repetition/possessive construction, not a natural license equivalent.
CHURCH — كنيست: كنيست refers to Knesset rather than church; a similar written form is not sufficient translation evidence.
COPY — علم: علم means knowledge/science/flag or a distinct verb, not a natural copy equivalent.
SCREEN — شاشة الشاشة: شاشة الشاشة is an unexplained duplicated possessive phrase, not a natural screen equivalent.
CAME — جيت: جيت is the colloquial came form in this relationship; جاء remains the separate approved MSA equivalent.
BRITISH — بريطانيا: بريطانيا is Britain, a country, not British as a person/adjective. This changes the referent rather than naturally adapting morphology.
